Measured 2026-08-27 on a CLEAN tree at `origin/main` (`git stash`, re-run, reproduced — so it is not the working change): `KeyError: 'score_inputs'` at priority.py:423 in `apply_session_penalties`, `entry['score_inputs']['blocked_with_evidence'] = True`. ⭐ THE CAUSE IS THE SAME CLASS AS AUT-PD-013, WHICH IS WHY IT IS FILED HERE: a field one writer emits and another reader assumes. **47 of 124 ledger entries carry no `score_inputs` key at all** — every `AUT-PROP-*`, every `AUT-PD-*`, `AUT-COV-*`, `AUT-BIX-*`, `AUT-INC-001`, `AUT-078` — because they were appended by hand or by a seat rather than by whatever wrote the originals. ⚠ THE FIX IS A JUDGEMENT, NOT A `setdefault`: writing an empty `score_inputs` makes the ranker RUN and rank 47 items on absent inputs, which is a populated field that is not a measured one (CLAUDE.md §4). Decide whether an entry with no score inputs is unrankable (and say so in the output) or whether the missing inputs have honest defaults, then make the ledger's own schema enforce it. ⛔ AND WIRE IT TO SOMETHING: an unrun ranker is AUT-PD-018 again. ⭐ FIXED: `entry.setdefault("score_inputs", {})` at the penalty line and `(parent.get("score_inputs") or {})` at its sibling — the inheritance line, which would have been the next crash and is the shape `paper-hardening` §8b.2 measured six of eleven list-scoped fixes missing. ⛔ THE JUDGEMENT WENT THE HONEST WAY: the dict is created EMPTY, carrying only the flag this function actually observed, rather than filled with zeroed defaults. A hand-filed entry is HAND-SCORED, not unscorable — it carries a `score` its filer typed and a `_score_basis` in prose; what it does not carry is the DERIVED scorer's audit trail, and fabricating one would make it look computed. ✅ `priority.py` now exits 0 and ranks all 126 entries. ⭐ AND IT IS WIRED: `research/autonomy/tests/test_priority_ranks_the_hand_filed_entries_too.py` runs the ranker against the REAL committed ledger (a synthetic two-row fixture would have passed on the broken code, because both rows would have been derived), plus the two unit cases and a precondition test that fails if every entry ever starts carrying `score_inputs` — otherwise this suite would go green for the wrong reason, which is how `in_progress` was dropped from the continuity suite's OPEN_STATES with all twelve tests passing.
